title: Phishing Incident Host Isolation & Perimeter Domain Block

purpose.text: Automated playbook for rapid containment of compromised endpoints involved in phishing incidents, including host isolation, perimeter domain blocking, user session revocation, and DNS cache flushing. This playbook orchestrates actions from a Windows PowerShell environment, targeting both Windows endpoints and Linux-based network devices via SSH.

scope.text: Applies to security operations and authorized agents.

roles.responsibility: Executes Phishing Incident Host Isolation & Perimeter Domain Block

steps.action: Query Falcon sensor API to retrieve the target host's device identifier.
steps.expected_outcome: Extract the first line of stdout as variables.device_id. If stdout is empty or contains an error, set variables.device_id = null.
steps.quote: Query Falcon sensor API to retrieve the target host's device identifier.

steps.action: Execute immediate network containment on the compromised endpoint via Falcon.
steps.expected_outcome: If stdout contains 'Action completed successfully' or similar success message, set variables.host_contained = true, else set variables.host_contained = false.
steps.quote: Execute immediate network containment on the compromised endpoint via Falcon.

steps.action: Push the malicious phishing domain indicator to the perimeter firewall blacklist.
steps.input: ssh soc-admin@firewall.corp.internal "configure; set security address-book Malicious_Domains address {{entities.malicious_domain}}; commit"
steps.expected_outcome: If stdout contains 'commit complete', set variables.domain_blocked = true, else set variables.domain_blocked = false.
steps.quote: Push the malicious phishing domain indicator to the perimeter firewall blacklist.

steps.action: Revoke all active enterprise authentication sessions and refresh tokens for the compromised user.
steps.expected_outcome: If exit code is 0, set variables.user_sessions_revoked = true, else set variables.user_sessions_revoked = false.
steps.quote: Revoke all active enterprise authentication sessions and refresh tokens for the compromised user.

steps.action: Flush the edge DNS resolver cache to prevent further resolution of the malicious domain.
steps.expected_outcome: If exit code is 0, set variables.dns_cache_flushed = true, else set variables.dns_cache_flushed = false.
steps.quote: Flush the edge DNS resolver cache to prevent further resolution of the malicious domain.
